look: XORA site look, same as the V00 welcome film: deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet edges, fictional market lines drawing in, calm eased motion, the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: Checkpoint one
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 1 checkpoint CP1, Foundations Checkpoint; the tutor walks in.

scenes.name: How it works
scenes.desc: Eight questions from T01 to T04: read, pause, pick, countdown, see why. Not graded.

scenes.name: Question 1
scenes.desc: T01: what a cryptocurrency is; a shared ledger fills in and is copied.

scenes.name: Question 2
scenes.desc: T01: 0.005 BTC at 60,000 USDT is worth 300 USDT.

scenes.name: Question 3
scenes.desc: T02: more buyers than sellers; the price tends to rise, but nothing is guaranteed.

scenes.name: Question 4
scenes.desc: T02: volatility is the size and speed of price swings in both directions.

scenes.name: Question 5
scenes.desc: T03: in BTC/USDT, BTC is the base and USDT the quote.

scenes.name: Question 6
scenes.desc: T03: 0.001 BTC at 65,000 USDT is 65 USDT of notional value.

scenes.name: Question 7
scenes.desc: T04: best ask 60,010 minus best bid 59,990 is a spread of 20 USDT.

scenes.name: Question 8
scenes.desc: T04: a message asks for your OTP; never share it.

scenes.name: Critical safety
scenes.desc: Exchange is not a bank, never share codes, stablecoin peg not guaranteed, you can always wait.

scenes.name: Where to revisit
scenes.desc: Which lesson each question came from; rewatch with no penalty.

scenes.name: Up next
scenes.desc: End card: Phase 2 starts with T05, Buy, Sell, Long and Short.
